Reduce noise in the agent activity views. In `src/ui/narrator.ts`, summarize `execute_code` tool calls with a concise "Running code batch" label instead of the serialized arguments. In `src/ui/worker-list.tsx`, hide routine worker log lines while keeping task/step status and errors visible, and show one normalized, truncated log line when a worker fails.

The regression test(s) for this change are already in the worktree: `src/ui/narrator.test.ts`, `src/ui/worker-list.test.ts`. Read them to see the exact API and behaviour expected, then implement the change so they pass. Do not modify the test files; they are restored before verification. Run the tests with `npx tsx --test src/ui/narrator.test.ts src/ui/worker-list.test.ts` and `npm run typecheck` before you finish.
